adme.title: Pharmacokinetic profile of novel multi-layer stable effervescent tablet: a cross-over study with an established European brand in healthy young male adults
adme.formulation: Paracetamol effervescent test product and Efferalgan reference product
adme.conditions: Randomized, single-dose, two-way crossover in 12 healthy male adults; fasted overnight; 7-day washout. Reference: 500 mg paracetamol. Blood sampled through 480 minutes. Table 2 summaries retain reported mean ± SD and standard error.
adme.limitations: These are study-specific pharmacokinetic summaries, not a measured concentration-time series or individual patient data. Table 2 gives reference Tmax 0.83 ± 0.25 h; the narrative also prints 0.93, so the table value is retained and the inconsistency disclosed. No bioequivalence conclusion or food/organ-function effects are inferred here.
adme.transcriptionMethod: Extracted from archived JATS table cells; rowspans expanded without inventing observations.

toxicology.title: Effect of the long-term use of a NOAEL dose of acetaminophen (paracetamol) on hepatic, renal, and neural tissues of aged albino rats
toxicology.formulation: Aged male Wistar rats exposed to acetaminophen (APAP)
toxicology.conditions: Rats were 24 months old; APAP-treated animals received 500 mg/kg body weight daily. Five treated and five control animals were sacrificed at 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 weeks. The source reports one control row and means with SD. Letter suffixes a/b/c are the source’s statistical grouping annotations.
toxicology.limitations: Animal research only. These observations are not human dose limits, safety probabilities or treatment guidance. No human risk prediction, interpolation between time points or unreported control series is created. Units, statistical letters and the single published control row are retained.
toxicology.transcriptionMethod: Extracted from archived JATS table cells; rowspans expanded without inventing observations.

api-synthesis.title: Mechanochemical Catalytic Transfer Hydrogenation of Aromatic Nitro Derivatives
api-synthesis.conditions: Primary research, Results section and Scheme 2b. The acetylation used equimolar 4-aminophenol and acetic anhydride, milling for 30 minutes with silica in Teflon equipment. The authors report isolated products on a gram scale.
api-synthesis.limitations: This published solid-state route differs from the solution-phase teaching reactor. Yield, amount and mass are quoted as reported; no replicate uncertainty, reaction time-course or TLC observations are invented. The two yields are individual steps, not an asserted overall route yield.
api-synthesis.transcriptionMethod: Amounts, isolated masses and step yields extracted from the archived Results paragraph mentioning 0.99 g; not calculated from simulator parameters.

medicinal-chemistry.conditions: Primary study Table 2. Eight compound concentrations incubated with HMG-CoA (20 µM) and HMG-CoA reductase (0.9 µg/mL) for 3 minutes. Selected compounds: triplicate incubations; IC50 mean ± SD in nM.
